reviews.text: I had to go abroad, so I used your service this time. Because my ferrets suffer from separation anxiety and are elderly, I was worried about leaving them at a pet hotel and decided to try a pet sitter instead. This was my first time using the service, but I was able to rest assured knowing that you sent me videos and photos of my pets being well cared for each time! I am so grateful for the careful care and affection you showed them each time! I would definitely like to use your service again next time! Thank you so much!

I usually use your services for short periods, but this time I asked you to take care of my two dogs while I was traveling abroad.

You cared for each dog with love and attention, without forcing anything on them.

You were very sensitive to any changes in their condition, and I appreciate that you shared my concerns and responded appropriately. My 12-year-old senior dog was already affectionate, but my 7-year-old rescue dog initially ran away. Thanks to this longer-term care, we've become very close, which is a great relief.

The sitting report was detailed and thorough, and you sent plenty of photos and videos, which was very helpful in understanding how they were doing. I hope to continue our relationship for a long time to come. Thank you very much!
I requested pet sitting twice a day for 10 days. They took perfect care of my pet.
I can always entrust them with confidence! Highly recommended!

They take excellent care of my dog ​​and send detailed reports, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in their care.
This time, I requested dog walking and care services for my summer visit home after a two-year absence.
I was so glad they were able to accommodate my request, even though it was right before the busy season.

I used a pet sitter for the first time because my dog ​​became ill at the pet hotel I usually use. They provided thorough pre-service consultations and even gave me updates before the service began.

They meticulously filmed my dog's condition and sent photos of his stool, which reassured me about his health. ☺️
As expected of a professional, even though my dog ​​is a picky eater, they stayed close to him and fed him directly from my hand, and he finished everything! They seem to understand my dog ​​better than I do! 🤣
I'll definitely use their services again when traveling!

For five days, you came twice a day, at lunchtime and in the evening, to take care of our small dog.

This was our first time using a pet sitter, and my dog ​​has a chronic illness, so I was really worried about leaving my beloved pet behind while I went abroad. However, you sent me detailed reports, lots of videos, and photos every day, which put my mind at ease. It was clear that you understood both the feelings of the pet and the owner when taking care of our dog. I would definitely like to use your services again. Thank you so much!

I requested their services while I was traveling.

They sent me incredibly detailed reports and videos every day, and the cats were already attached to them from the initial consultation. I received videos of them happily cuddling every day.

They were a very trustworthy pet sitter, and my cats felt safe and comfortable with them! Thank you so much!

This pet sitter was incredibly trustworthy!

They sent photos and videos of my pet, which gave me peace of mind.

My pet quickly warmed up to them, and I could tell they were treating my pet with love and care.

Not only did they take care of my pet, but they also kept the room clean, for which I am truly grateful.

I would definitely like to use their services again!

We requested a 2-night, 3-day stay.

They conducted a thorough and detailed consultation, covering everything from daily care to veterinary arrangements in case of emergencies.

One of our cats immediately became affectionate towards the staff member, which gave us peace of mind.

We were surprised to see our timid female cat, who usually only shows herself to family, approaching the staff member on her own while we were away.

In addition to the report, they provided detailed updates with videos and photos.

They played with our cats plenty, fed them and used the litter box exactly as we requested, and even cleaned the house after our first 2-night, 3-day absence. Our room was spotless when we returned!

Our cats greeted us as if nothing had happened.

We felt that the staff member not only cared for our cats but also understood our feelings as their owners, and we are truly glad we chose them.

We will definitely use their services again when we travel in the future.

I had to leave my newly adopted rescue dog alone for a few hours, so I urgently requested your services.

It was my first time using a pet sitter, but they took excellent care of him, and I was relieved that everything went smoothly.
Highly recommend! My cat was well taken care of. Pet sitter sent regular updates, photo and video - I can tell my cat felt comfortable. Will definitely book again.

I've used this pet sitter many times to care for my three cats, and they've always been very kind to me. They also provide very detailed reports, which I really appreciate. One of my cats, who doesn't get along with anyone but me, has become very attached to this pet sitter, which always amazes me. Thank you so much for everything. I look forward to working with you again.

I had to leave home for an extended period unexpectedly and requested their services. From the initial consultation to the day of care, they provided very thorough support and detailed reports, and I was relieved to see that my pet seemed to be able to stay without stress.

This time I asked for a sitter for three days. The dog was very attached to me, so I felt at ease. The sitter reports were very detailed, so I could trust them very much! I was very happy that the dog greeted me cheerfully and in good health! Thank you very much!
Thank you for always taking such good care of my pets. I can see that from the photos and videos, so I feel at ease knowing I can leave them in your care.

Thank you so much for the detailed report and for taking such good care of the cats! Thank you also for sending so many photos and videos 😊
I look forward to working with you again in the future! …

This time, I requested 1 hour each in the morning and evening for a 3-night, 4-day stay. I have two cats.

From the initial consultation, they were very kind and attentive, and I felt at ease even before entrusting them with the care.

On the day of care, they sent videos, photos, and daily reports each time. I was on a business trip abroad and not in Japan, so I couldn't rush there immediately if something happened, but I felt very reassured every day.

From the cats' behavior, it was clear that they were being treated with great care and affection.

I would definitely like to use their services again.

Thank you very much for everything.

I always entrust my 13-year-old senior cat to your care.

She's a very difficult cat, but perhaps because you take such good care of her, she strangely trusts you, and I feel completely at ease relying on you.

Thank you so much.

Thank you so much for your incredibly attentive service.

You're a very trustworthy pet sitter, with meticulous care for both my elderly dog ​​who needs medication and my playful puppy.

I've already recommended you to a friend, and I definitely want to use your services again.

Thank you again for everything.

I used this service when I was away from home for several days on a family trip.

My cat is usually shy and hides behind things when strangers come over, but I was surprised that she immediately came out and let me pet her after seeing the video!

She seemed to intuitively understand that I was a safe person, and she was more affectionate than I've ever seen her, which gave me great peace of mind.

I was also very grateful that they watered the plants and ventilated the house while I was away.

I would definitely like to use this service again!

I was so impressed by their incredibly attentive service!

They even provided a report that was so detailed it was almost excessive! It really lifted a weight off my shoulders. I'd like to use their services not only for travel but also when I'm overwhelmed with work.

My dog ​​broke his leg and I couldn't take him for walks anymore, so I was indebted to them for four months until he recovered. They consulted with me every step of the way about when to take him for walks, and they recorded his walks with videos and photos. They truly cared for my dog. I would definitely like to use their services again.

I am extremely satisfied with the very careful and attentive care I received. Even though I requested a last-minute change of date and time the day before, they were very flexible in accommodating my request. They carefully inquired about my dog's characteristics and how I give treats beforehand, and followed those instructions precisely. I also appreciated receiving many photos and videos of my dog ​​during the care process, which allowed me to see how he was doing.

I will definitely use their services again!

The care and cleaning were very thorough, and the detailed reports were very reassuring. Photographs were included, making the progress easy to follow.

My pet was very satisfied with the care they provided in just 60 minutes while I was away, and it's a service I would like to continue using.

Thank you for your continued support.

I requested your services for the care of my two Ragdoll cats during my two-night, three-day visit home. From the initial consultation to the day of the service, your consistently courteous service put me at ease. I was surprised to see how relaxed and affectionate the two cats were, as evidenced by the numerous videos and photos you provided during the sitting. It was touching to see how you understood their feelings and treated them accordingly.

Furthermore, you even watered the plants, took out the plastic bottles, and cleaned, allowing me to spend my time at home with peace of mind, almost as if I hadn't been away at all.

I would definitely like to request your services again.

Thank you very much 😊

We hired a cat sitter for three days while we went on a family trip. They visited our home beforehand and carefully listened to our needs.

During the trip, they provided detailed updates on our cat's condition every day, with lots of photos and videos, and even cleaned up the grass vomit and maintained the air purifier.

Our cat is very shy, so seeing how much the sitter loved her was a testament to how attentive and warm she was to our needs.

It was an excellent service that I would definitely like to request again next time. Thank you very much.

I was impressed by the care provided, which showed an understanding of the dog's behavior, and by the kind and gentle demeanor of the staff member in charge.

The detailed completion report, which included photos and videos, made it easy to understand what kind of care was provided, which was reassuring.

They were very trustworthy! It was my first time using a pet sitter, but I was impressed by how thorough the pre-service consultation was.

I was surprised to see my female cat, who usually doesn't warm up to me at all and rarely shows herself, approaching me on her own.

The detailed photo updates gave me peace of mind!

My male cat also got plenty of playtime, and feeding and litter box care were done exactly as I requested.

They even vacuumed, so when I returned home after my first 2-night, 3-day absence, the house was incredibly clean!

I will definitely use their services again when I travel in the future.

Thank you very much.

This was my first time using this pet sitter, but the pre-consultation was very thorough, and the care was tailored to my dog's personality and daily routine. I was also given detailed care reports, photos, and even videos, which gave me great peace of mind. I'm very satisfied! I would definitely use their services again.

In addition, it seems she is a certified pet nutritionist, so she gave me very detailed information about food and treats. She told me that the "domestic horse meat chips" are a well-balanced treat, and I'm still trying them out, so they seem like a good choice.

I requested your help in taking care of my cats while I was away for two days and one night.

The initial consultation was very detailed, with many questions, which gave me peace of mind.

During the sitting, the sitter provided very thorough reports and even sent videos, making them a very trustworthy pet sitter.

Also, even my shy cat warmed up to you, so it seems you're someone cats like.

Thank you very much for everything.

I requested care for my two cats and rabbit while I was traveling.

The thorough consultation put me at ease.

The detailed reports I received were also very much appreciated. I was also very grateful that they took care of my plants. I will definitely use your services again. Thank you very much.
